verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a Torch developer portal that documents a Case Status API and a FOIA API, plus a sandbox for sending test data, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API reference (such as a try-it console or Swagger-style explorer) or runnable examples. A sandbox for test traffic is a separate environment, not an interactive reference, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
